status_vocabulary.DONE: built as the board draws it; evidence cites the code

caveats: Audited at c4ce1e2. The handoff lists no T-246..T-255 commit touching the Account hub or these lists (T-250/T-251 touch local History/Favorites, not AO3's).
No Xcode: source reading only. No signed-in screen was seen.

boards.title: Account hub
boards.spec_label: Username as the page title, four scopes as a segmented control; Overview = six shortcuts + Preferences + More on AO3; the wash, pill fills and icons derive from the app accent.

items.what: Scopes as a segmented control
items.note: Owner flattened the hub: Shortcuts, then Reading / Writing / Activity groups, then Account (Preferences, More on AO3). Recorded at the call site so nobody restores the pills.

items.what: Identity header, accent wash, tappable shortcuts with cached counts
items.note: Counts are AO3AccountListCount.displayText: exact, or 'N+' for a paged lower bound; nothing is fetched just for a tile.

items.what: Tile counts stay AO3's exact figures
items.failure_scenario: The dashboard nav seeds Bookmarks with AO3's exact 'Bookmarks (10)', which counts every bookmark (BookmarkQuery: works, series, external, private for the owner). Opening a one-page Bookmarks list records AO3AccountListCount(itemsOnPage: 7, totalPages: 1) because parseAuthorBookmarksPage keeps only the 7 work rows; 'two exact counts are both totals, so the newer one wins', and the tile now reads 7. History and Marked for Later drop rows for deleted works the same way.
items.fix: Record a list page as exact only when every row on it parsed (carry the raw row count from the parser, e.g. li.bookmark.blurb / li.reading count); otherwise record it as a lower bound, which never overrides an exact dashboard figure.
items.test: AO3AccountListCount(parsedRows: 7, rawRows: 10, totalPages: 1).exact == nil and it does not replace a cached exact 10.

items.what: Dead compact branch still carries the scope control
items.note: libraryStyleCompactRoot draws SubjectSegmentedControl(AccountTab) but is only used when showsWorkListControls is true, which no scope returns any more; the type's doc and ARCHITECTURE_MAP still describe 'primary segments Overview / Reading / Writing / Activity'. Stale docs are a hallucination source (AGENT_ONBOARDING DoD 3).
items.fix: Correct the two docs; delete the unreachable branch in its own commit, or leave it and say it is unreachable.

items.what: Scope pills in the preview

boards.title: Marked for Later
boards.spec_label: Covers for what changed since your last visit (NEW badge), ledger rows for the rest; pills All / Updated / Downloaded / Reset; header 'N works - synced N min ago'; footer 'Marked for Later lives on AO3 - unmarking here unmarks there. Pagination follows the ledger'.

items.what: Updated covers + ledger rows, pills with Reset, Downloaded size line
Header count reads as a total on a paged list
items.failure_scenario: A 9-page Marked for Later list shows '20 works - synced 2 min ago' at the top of page 1. Every other account list appends 'page 1 of 9' (headerTallyLine; Bookmarks' own subtitle); this one was carved out for its sync stamp and lost the page clause, so the page's count reads as the list's size.
items.fix: AO3MarkedForLaterCopy.subtitle(workCount:syncedAt:currentPage:totalPages:) appending ' - page X of Y' when totalPages > 1.
items.test: subtitle(workCount: 20, syncedAt: t, currentPage: 1, totalPages: 9) contains 'page 1 of 9'; one page -> no page clause.

items.what: Footer promises unmarking
items.failure_scenario: The footer says 'unmarking here unmarks there', but this screen has no unmark control and the app has no unmark write (only markForLater, which adds). A reader looks for an action the copy promised.
items.fix: Until an unmark exists, say only 'Marked for Later lives on AO3.' plus the pagination sentence. The unmark itself is filed for the owner (it is an AO3 write).

items.what: Unmark swipe (PATCH /works/:id/mark_as_read)
items.note: An AO3 write; the handoff allows building write UI only where it says so. Shape would mirror markForLater (CSRF from the work page, _method=patch) behind a confirm.

'X NEW' badge from a device watermark; chapter range; Mark All as Seen
Header '104 total'
items.note: AO3 prints no subscriptions total, so the header says 'N works' for the page plus 'page X of Y'. Honest.

items.what: Works / Series / Authors scope pills
items.note: The list asks for type=works only. Series and user subscriptions are name + byline rows on the same index (dl.subscription dt), not work blurbs, so each scope needs its own row and its own fetch.

items.what: Updated run as 164x232 covers
items.note: Rows kept so the chapter range and the unsubscribe swipe have somewhere to attach; reasoning in the doc comment.

items.what: Refine over sparse subscription rows
items.failure_scenario: The Filter button is offered on Subscriptions. visibleWorks applies the refine facets to `works` - the index rows, which carry no fandoms, rating, completion or language (AO3WorkSummary.subscription). Set a rating, a fandom, Complete or a language and every row fails, so the screen says 'No works on this page match the current filters' although the enriched summaries (enrichedSubscriptionSummaries) show matching works. The panel's '0 of 25 on this page match' line is wrong the same way.
items.fix: For .subscriptions, refine over works.map { enrichedSubscriptionSummaries[$0.id] ?? $0 } and keep rows whose summary is still sparse (unknown is not a mismatch); pass the same array as refineSource. Or hide the Filter button on Subscriptions, as the display-mode switch already is.
items.test: Pure: filters(rating: .teen).apply over [sparse row, enriched Teen row, enriched Explicit row] with 'unknown passes' keeps the first two.

items.what: Unsubscribe is a swipe behind a confirm; write is session-fenced

boards.title: Inbox
boards.spec_label: Activity wash; kicker/rule/32pt hero with tallies; the four filters (All / Unread / Awaiting reply / Replied) as a chip rail with a dashed Filter; rows with Reply (gated on AO3 rendering it), Mark read/unread, overflow, Replied pill, your reply quoted; paging pill.

items.what: Header tally mixes site totals with a page-only count
items.failure_scenario: '1,204 comments - 12 unread - 3 awaiting your reply': the first two are AO3's own heading ('My Inbox (N comments, M unread)'), the third counts only the 20 loaded comments. On a 60-page inbox the line reads as if 3 comments site-wide await a reply. The code comment knows; the screen does not say.
items.fix: When model.totalPages > 1, word the clause '3 awaiting your reply on this page'.
items.test: Pure tally(total: 1204, unread: 12, awaitingOnPage: 3, totalPages: 60) ends with 'on this page'; totalPages 1 -> no suffix.

items.what: Filter chip rail (All / Unread / Awaiting reply / Replied)
items.note: Filtering is AO3's own parsed GET form in a sheet (read / replied-to / date); no pill rail. 'Awaiting reply' is an inference AO3 cannot filter server-side, so as a pill it can only narrow the loaded page.

items.what: Row actions: Reply gated on AO3's rendered form, Replied pill, select and bulk bar
Paging pill
